book.name: Nen Galati Mo
book.title: Lepran Ɗe Pool Ran Nen Galati Mo

content: Wu Ɓamshak

Ɗyemnaa mo, katɗang mee gurum taa pal, ɓe wun ɗe wun a ɗe ɓalɓal nɗǝǝn Riin Naan wu ɓam wur, mbǝkǝ wur tuwap ɗe. Wu sham kǝ káa fuu mo, kaaɗe wun nkaa ɓam wur. Wu tap kǝ káa fuu, mbǝkǝ taji wun wu waa wu ɗel nɗǝǝn jwaan nǝ kas.
Wu ɓamshak, katɗang wu cìn aasǝ ɓe wu gam Wàar Kristi mǝnǝ.
Katɗang memee fuu lekáa wur a mee mbii, ɗangɓe nɗǝǝn zeen nǝ, ɓe baa wur a mee mbii kas, ɓe gwar mǝnǝ nǝk a kaa shin ɓejee ɗak.
Ɗang nǝ ret kǝ, koo a wii ɓe wur cam ɗak wur, ɗangɓe wur nleshap shikáa shin, baa ashak kǝ ɗewur kám shin kǝ mee gurum kas.
Koo a weyi nɗǝǝn wun ɓe wur mang toon kǝ mbii ɗewur cìn mo shikáa wur.
Koo weyi ɗewur nkaa lap kámpwoo Naan, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ wur ɓàk mbii ɗeret mo jir, ashak kǝ ngukám nǝ.
Taji mee gurum gwamkáa shin kas, mbǝɗe baa mee ngwe cam zaal nNaan kas. Mbii ɗe gurum kop ɓe wur nɗyiip a nǝ.
Ngwe ɗewur kop a nɗǝǝn nan nwur, ɓe wur nɗyiip a mbii ɗewam nɗǝǝn nan nǝ. Ɗang ngwe ɗewur kop nɗǝǝn Riin Naan, ɓe nɗǝǝn Riin ɓe wur nɗyiip a seen ɗe ngaa-ngaa.
Taji kwak fun mo waam mbǝ cìn mbii ɗeret mo kas, mbǝɗe katɗang pee nǝ wul, ɓe mun nɗyiip ɗeret mǝ ɗak fun mo, ka baa mu taa mu muutleet kas.
Aasǝ, nǝ ret kǝ mu cìn mbii ɗeret mo, kaaɗe mu katpee nǝ sǝ. Mu cìn mbii ɗeret ngurum mo jir, met jir, a ɗyemnǝǝn fun mo, ɗe mo a nendǝm nɗang Kristi mo.
Pwoo Ɗe Mǝ Kyes Nǝ Mo
Ran ɗenan-nan ɗe wu naa sǝ mo, a an ran mo shi sar fen shindǝm nwun.
A nen ɗe mo rǝɓet leshap nɗǝǝn nan ɗesǝ, a moo rǝɓet letǝng nwun, mbǝkǝ wu can-can ɗe, kǝzak, mbǝkǝ taji mo shwaajeel, mbǝ shiyeepyoom Kristi kas.
Nen ɗe moo ten can mo, mo shikáa fur, baa mo kyeer wàar nǝ kas. Ɗangɓe nǝ a rǝɓet kǝ mo, kǝ mo can wun, mbǝkǝ mo katpee ɗe mbǝ canpwoo nkaa wun nɗǝǝn nan.

Ɗangɓe pee wen ɗe ɓe a shi shiyeepyoom Daa fun Jesu Kristi, a nǝ a mbii mǝndong ɗe nǝ mmak le kǝ nghan canpwoo ɓejee ɗak. A mbǝ shiyeepmúut wur, ɓe mbii ɗe mǝ nyil ɗesǝ mo, baa mo kuɗi mee koop nǝ pee ghan ɗe kas. Nǝ ɗee a kaa moo ten pwas mo nkaa shiyeepmúut Kristi, kǝzak, an a kaa ngwe ɗe kǝ ten muut sǝ, har wen kǝn yit mbii mǝ nyil ɗesǝ mo mɓwoon.
Koo ɗe mo can gurum, kǝ koo ɗe baa mo can gurum kas, ɓe baa nǝ kǝ mee koop nǝ kas. Mbii ɗe nǝ kǝkoop nǝ hakyeng nǝ nɗesǝ, Naan wur shin seen ɗepwoo mun.
Mbǝ ɗe mo kǝ mwaan nɗǝǝn seen ɗepwoo ɗesǝ nǝ, ɓe mo a nen Naan mo azeen. Moo tongryang kǝ Naan kǝ wur naa mo shi yit naajeel zak.
Yool yaksǝ, ɓe baa ɗyen nwen kǝ mee gurum daampee nwen zak kas, mbǝɗe nǝmer ɗe mo nkaa an mo kám nǝ, an a kǝrem mǝ Jesu.
Ɗyemnaa mo, ɗeret mǝ Daa fun Jesu Kristi nǝ tong ashak kǝ riin fuu mo jir. Nǝ a kǝsǝ.
